description: Split a long text into chunks for retrieval (RAG): split on paragraphs, then sentences, then words, each chunk within maxTokens (default 500) with the overlap you ask for (default 50 tokens). Each chunk has its index, text, start and end character offsets and an estimated token count (characters divided by 4, a rough rule for English). Up to 1 MB and 2,000 chunks. Choose this tool for: Generate overlapping text chunks with character offsets. Close alternatives on this server: hash (Generate MD5, SHA and CRC-32 hashes of text); image (Generate an image from a text prompt). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

maxTokens.description: Largest chunk in estimated tokens, 20 to 8000, default 500

overlap.description: Tokens shared by neighbouring chunks, 0 up to maxTokens minus 1, default 50

text.description: The text, up to 1 MB (JSON body field)

name: text_chunk
title: Generate overlapping text chunks with character offsets
